session.name: MPI-567 session 11b - the ControlNet mapping bug Fabio found by eye, plus five UI items, all validated on real renders

goal.original: Rename the op, add the brush-preset dropdown, draw the doodle on the box step - then whatever Fabio's live look turns up.
goal.summary: All three landed, and his live look then found a REAL BUG: the flow mapped ControlNet twice as hard as the rest of the app AND steered to the final denoise step. Fixed to byte parity with the SDXL template, and he confirmed clean renders after. Four more UI items shipped on top. HIS WORDS: 'Your changes are all validated, by the way.' The open problem is now STYLE - the rendered object comes back in a different style from the photo, and widening the box as a style reference was tried and did not work.

completed: THE CONTROLNET MAPPING WAS THIS FLOW'S OWN, NOT THE APP'S, and it was producing bad renders. Fabio: 'every time I go over a 50 I start getting these lines that look like poop.' TWO axes diverged and only one was ever documented: the slider mapped 0-1 to 0-1 where all eight other ControlNet workflows map 0-1 to 0-0.5, AND end_percent was 1 where every other graph releases at 0.569. So 0.50 on his slider was already DOUBLE the app's maximum, held to the final denoise step. promptControlDefaults.js states the rule outright - the remap exists 'because past ~0.5 those ControlNets artefact'. Now byte-identical to t2i_sdxl_realistic (nodes 22/23/24) in the runtime graph AND its raw twin, default moved to PROMPT_CONTROL_DEFAULTS.controlStrength (1). He re-ran it and confirmed clean output - FLOWSCRIBOBJ_006/_007 in his gallery.

A NEW SWEEP TEST pins the house rule: every workflow carrying a ControlNetApplyAdvanced must have end_percent <= 0.6, and output_max == 0.5 wherever the user drives Input_Control_strength. It asserts it matched the scribble flow and >= 6 workflows, so it cannot pass by matching nothing. Two mutants (each restoring a shipped-before value) both RED, file restored byte-identical by sha256.

OP RENAMED flowScribbleObject -> flowScribObj. Free at appVersionIntroduced 1.5.0 against a released APP_VERSION 1.4.2. It was SIX files, not the five the old handoff listed - the key is matched BY NAME in the test suite too. That correction is now in docs/playbooks/add-flow/01-descriptor-and-ops.md, whose worked example also had a typo'd badge and a wrong file count.

FIVE UI ITEMS, every one of them a re-invention of something the canvas family already owned - which is exactly what MpiStepPaint's own header forbids for strokes. (1) Brush shape is an MpiDropdown of the ten BRUSH_PRESETS, persisted as `brush` so Reuse restores it; PaintManager.brushPreset already existed and the shared dab already read it. (2) Hold Space pans, Space+wheel zooms - the hand-rolled {offsetX,offsetY,scale} is now ViewManager, bringing minScale and isManagedView. (3) The cursor ring moved to brushDab.drawBrushRing, called from BOTH MpiCanvas and the step, so the eraser is frost-blue instead of the solid white circle both tools shared. (4) B and E arm brush and eraser, routed through the radio's setValue so the control and the manager cannot disagree. (5) The box step ghosts the drawing under its rectangle - NO frame change, because both steps declare role image1 and the frame merges gizmo reports per role.

MpiClearVram added before the output (Fabio, 'in the spirit of all the other workflows') - this was the ONLY graph in comfy_workflows/ without one. Node 170 between the stitch and Output_Image, the same position Head Swap and Outpaint use. graph_parity.py correctly FAILED on the rewire and was given an ALLOW entry with the reason.

THE SHADOW SCARE WAS A PIXEL FLOOR, and Fabio diagnosed it himself: a small object boxed in a small source had no usable contact shadow, and the SAME drawing on a 2x upscaled source produced a correct one. Written up in docs/playbooks/add-flow/blending-into-a-photo.md as a new section - same starvation the ~96px ink floor describes one stage earlier.
703 tests pass. Commit adc5ea7c, UNPUSHED, on top of earlier unpushed commits shared with a peer session.
pending: STYLE PICKING ON THE LAST PHASE - the biggest open item and probably its own card. The rendered object comes back in a DIFFERENT STYLE from the photo (a semi-realistic crab into a flat-shaded cartoon beach). Fabio TRIED widening the box so the model could see the existing character as a style reference and IT DID NOT WORK - so the style has to be DECLARED, not inferred. His direction: hook up the styles portion of Klein 4B and 9B and let the user pick a style in the last phase, reusing the existing style picker. His own cost estimate, do not discount it: 'it's not easy either... which means we would need two different workflows, I think.' Open questions are written into plan.md under Remaining Work - chiefly whether MpiStylePicker (an INDEX-valued Primitive, not an MpiDropdown) can live in a flow's declared fields at all, and whether the existing two-arm Input_Edit_Model / Input_Edit_Clip modelParams already covers 4B vs 9B without a second workflow.

RE-SWEEP THE CONTROL STRENGTH BAND. The FlowDef's measured 0.30-0.60 / 0.80 ink-as-clothing / 1.00 lines-as-straps numbers were swept at the OLD mapping - they are RAW strengths at end_percent 1 and do NOT convert to slider positions now. Marked historical in the FlowDef and the field note rewritten to describe the symptom instead. Fabio has been running at 0.7 successfully on the new mapping; get a real band before quoting a number.

Graphics (tile + hero) do not exist and it is not silent - his console spams repeating 404s for flow-scribble-object.webp and .mp4. Separate /mpi-flow-graphics pass. The filenames follow the flow ID, which the op rename did NOT change, so it is unblocked.
The reuse round trip has still never been run. That plus a live run is 05-verify.md's Definition of Done and is what closes this card.

The box step still defaults to the WHOLE IMAGE. Auto-seeding from the drawing's alpha bbox is designed and NOT built - and note the tension with the shadow finding: a tight auto-box is exactly what starves a shadow of pixels, so it needs a pixel floor, not just a bbox.

NOTICED, NOT ACTIONED, both Fabio's call: this flow's Output_Image is a SaveImage where every other flow uses PreviewImage (it writes an extra copy into the engine's output dir that nothing collects, and looks like an authoring leftover); and flow_ltx_extend / flow_ltx_foley also have no MpiClearVram despite running LTX 2.3.
At close-out: heal this card's acceptance list - it still says 'Canny for a clean structured drawing' when canny's real niche is a TONAL drawing.

key_decisions: DURABLE FINDINGS GO IN docs/, NOT ON THE CARD (Fabio, explicit and repeated). Cards get deleted and MPI-596 needs them. This session added the shadow/pixel-floor finding to blending-into-a-photo.md, the six-files rename correction to 01-descriptor-and-ops.md, and reversed two of paint-gizmo.md's own rulings in place with the reason recorded.

A HOUSE RULE THAT ONE GRAPH BREAKS IS INVISIBLE UNTIL A USER SEES IT. Both bugs found this session were the same shape - the scribble flow being the sole outlier among 30-odd workflows, once on the ControlNet mapping and once on the missing MpiClearVram. When touching a graph, sweep comfy_workflows/ for what the others do before assuming this one is right.

MPI-606 SHIPPED (commit c4dacc0c) and freed the spacebar, which is what unblocked hold-space pan. Its files - MpiBaseFlow.js, MpiColorPicker.js, hotkeyRegistry.js, ui/carousel-frame.md - were never edited from this card, and MPI-567's stale claim on the first and last of those was released.

NO NEW HOTKEY IDS WERE INVENTED. Space uses the existing canvas.pan.start / canvas.pan.end, B and E use mask.brush.toolbar / mask.eraser.toolbar. Both InputController and this step bind them and every handler for an id fires - harmless, because the workspace canvas only pans on a mousedown ITS container receives and the flow overlay takes those.

NO TEST WAS ADDED FOR MpiClearVram, deliberately: 15 graphs legitimately lack one (resize, remove_background, the nvidia_pid family, both SeedVR2, and flow_ltx_extend / flow_ltx_foley), so a blanket sweep would encode a rule that is not true and an allowlist would drift.
constraints: HEREDOCS, BACKSLASH-NEWLINE CONTINUATIONS, AND BACKTICKS INSIDE A DOUBLE-QUOTED INLINE SCRIPT are all blocked by guard hooks, and the third one silently eats your code spans. Write a .py with the Write tool and run it by path; git commit -F <file> is how the commits here were made.

EDITING THE RAW GRAPH IS LINK SURGERY, NOT A VALUE EDIT. raw/ is LiteGraph: a link is [id, from_node, from_slot, to_node, to_slot, type], and inserting a node means re-targeting the existing link, appending a new one, and advancing BOTH last_node_id and last_link_id. Verify afterwards that both formats agree, link ids are unique, and every link resolves - a positionally shifted widgets_values or a dangling link is silent and ComfyUI still validates.

RE-RUN research/lanpaint/graph_parity.py AFTER ANY GRAPH EDIT. It caught the MpiClearVram rewire this session, which is it working - a deliberate deviation goes in its ALLOW table with a reason, never suppressed.
A MUTATION TEST MUST RESTORE IN `finally` AND VERIFY BY SHA256. Three mutation runs this session did.

TWO PROBE TRAPS THAT EACH RETURNED A CONFIDENT WRONG ANSWER: MpiDropdown PORTALS its option list to document.body, so querying inside the mount slot finds zero options and reads as a broken dropdown; and resolveMediaUrl rewrites any bare path to /project-file?path=..., so feeding a probe a static repo path 404s and leaves a zero-sized image that reads as a broken component. Also, the brush ring is DASHED, so it exact-matches ~19 pixels rather than hundreds - assert the relative flip between tools, never an absolute floor.
PUSH IS USER-AUTHORIZED even though project-profile.md says push_policy: auto - CLAUDE.md § Git and Commits wins. Commit adc5ea7c is UNPUSHED.
validate_board.py FAILS on ~21 PRE-EXISTING errors, all MPI-573's event log using the wrong shape plus one of its file-state records. Not yours, byte-identical in HEAD, do not 'fix' them here.

LAUNCH YOUR OWN APP WITH CUBRIC_AGENT_PROFILE POINTED SOMEWHERE FRESH. The default agent profile is held by an orphan from an earlier session and produces the single-instance lock signature - splash ERR_FAILED -2, exit 0, EPERM pruning the profile dir - which reads as a broken app and is not one. Kill your instance by PID-derived ancestry from ITS port, never by name or CommandLine: an agent instance and Fabio's live app share the byte-identical root electron.exe, and curl :3000 afterwards to prove his session survived.

Last session's work is ALL VALIDATED by Fabio on real renders - his words. The headline was a real bug he found by eye: the flow mapped ControlNet twice as hard as the rest of the app AND steered it to the final denoise step, so his strokes rendered as physical edges past 0.5 on the slider. It diverged on two axes from all eight other ControlNet workflows and only one axis had ever been documented; it is now byte-identical to t2i_sdxl_realistic, guarded by a sweep test, and confirmed clean in the app. Also shipped: the op rename to flowScribObj, a BRUSH_PRESETS dropdown, hold-Space pan/zoom, the shared brushDab.drawBrushRing cursor, B/E hotkeys, the doodle ghosted on the box step, and the MpiClearVram this was the only graph in the repo lacking. 703 tests pass, commit adc5ea7c, UNPUSHED. YOUR NEXT ACTION IS TO SCOPE STYLE PICKING WITH FABIO, NOT TO BUILD IT: the rendered object comes back in a different style from the photo, and he already TRIED widening the box so the model could see the existing character as a style reference - it did not work, so the style must be declared rather than inferred. His direction is to hook up the styles portion of Klein 4B and 9B and let the user pick a style in the last phase reusing the existing picker, and his own estimate is that it needs two workflows. plan.md's Remaining Work carries the open questions - chiefly whether MpiStylePicker (INDEX-valued, not an MpiDropdown) can live in a flow's declared fields at all, and whether the existing two-arm Input_Edit_Model / Input_Edit_Clip modelParams already covers 4B vs 9B without a second workflow. It probably wants its own card; ask him first. Three traps that will cost you: heredocs, backslash-newline continuations AND backticks inside a double-quoted inline script are all blocked by guard hooks, so write a .py and run it by path; editing raw/ is LiteGraph LINK SURGERY, not a value edit, and a dangling link is silent; and launch your own app with CUBRIC_AGENT_PROFILE pointed somewhere fresh, because the default agent profile is held by an orphan and its lock signature reads as a broken app.
